systemData.Description: Azure Resource Manager metadata containing createdBy and modifiedBy information.

currentKubernetesVersion.Description: Current Kubernetes version running on the cluster (e.g., '1.29').

targetKubernetesVersion.Description: Target Kubernetes version to evaluate for upgrade (e.g., '1.30').

assessmentTime.Description: UTC timestamp when the in-cluster agent last computed this assessment.

overallSeverity.Description: Rolled-up severity across all checks; highest severity wins.

componentCompatibility.Description: Per-component compatibility results with the target Kubernetes version.

deprecatedApis.Description: Deprecated Kubernetes APIs still in use in the cluster.

compatibilityStatus.Description: Compatibility of the component with the target Kubernetes version.

severity.Description: Severity associated with this compatibility result.

minCompatibleVersion.Description: Minimum component version known to be compatible with targetKubernetesVersion.

removedRelease.Description: Kubernetes release in which this API is removed (e.g., '1.32').

usageMetrics.Description: HTTP verb call counts observed for this deprecated API.

lastUsageObservedAt.Description: UTC timestamp of the last observed usage.

severity.Description: Severity of continued use of this deprecated API.

name.Description:
Subject of the check (node name, workload namespace/name, etc.).
Optional for cluster-wide checks.

details.Description: Human-readable reason when severity is not 'None'.

createdBy.Description: The identity that created the resource.

createdByType.Description: The type of identity that created the resource.

lastModifiedBy.Description: The identity that last modified the resource.

lastModifiedByType.Description: The type of identity that last modified the resource.

lastModifiedAt.Description: The timestamp of resource last modification (UTC)
